sections.description:
EZ Horoscope is the #1 Astrology, Horoscope, Tarot and Numerology platform for WordPress.

Transform Your WordPress Site with Outstanding Astrology Content
Everything you need to create fantastic astrology, tarot, and numerology content with accurate and engaging horoscopes updated daily.

⏱️ Quick setup – live in minutes
🔮 Seamlessly integrates horoscopes, tarot readings, and numerology insights
🎨 Customize the look and feel to match your site
🌍 Horoscope content available in 45+ languages
🗣️ New: AI Voice Agents for Your Website
Bring your horoscopes to life with AI-powered voice agents. EZ Horoscope now integrates with the Brilyi Voice Agent platform, allowing you to embed a conversational AI widget directly on your WordPress site.

Visitors can interact with your horoscopes by voice and text, ask questions, and receive spoken responses in real time. This feature boosts engagement, keeps readers on your site longer, and creates a modern, interactive astrology experience.

⚠️ Note: Voice Agent functionality requires an active Brilyi subscription.

Version 2.2 introduces the all-new EZ Horoscope Blocks, making it easier than ever to build beautifully structured, dynamic astrology pages with zero coding required. These blocks let you drag-and-drop fully rendered Daily, Weekly, Chinese, and individual Horoscope Section components, along with Zodac Sign Compatibility and Numerology reports directly into the WordPress editor, giving you complete flexibility over layout, design, and flow. Whether you’re building a single horoscope page or a full astrology portal, these blocks provide a seamless and modern editing experience that fits naturally into any theme.

Each block automatically fetches fresh, accurate horoscope content in 45+ languages and displays it instantly in both the editor and on the frontend. You can customize hero images, headings, layout styles, and individual content sections with intuitive controls—all while preserving your site’s typography and visual identity. These blocks make professional-grade horoscope pages accessible to everyone, empowering creators to launch stunning astrology content in minutes while boosting engagement, page views, and ad revenue effortlessly.

Premium Features

Upgrade to the Premium license for enhanced customization, premium content, and awesome features.

Here’s what’s included:

✅ Included: Daily & Weekly Horoscopes
Automatically updated in 45+ languages—no writing required. (Standalone value: $19/mo)

🐉 Included: Detailed Chinese Horoscopes
Authentic daily and yearly readings based on the Chinese zodiac. (Standalone value: $14/mo)

🔮 Included: Tarot Card Readings
Beautiful and accurate card spreads to deepen audience engagement. (Standalone value: $17/mo)

🔢 Included: Full Numerology Reports
Generate personalized life path, destiny, and soul number insights. (Standalone value: $25/mo)

❤️ Included: Sun Sign Compatibility Reports
Interactive compatibility insights that keep readers coming back. (Standalone value: $15/mo)

🚀 Included: Full Access to the EZ Horoscope Astrology API
Use our API to power your own applications, custom widgets, and more. (Standalone value: $99/mo)

🗣️ Included: AI Voice Agent Integration
Embed a “Talk to our AI” widget that lets visitors speak with a virtual astrologer for personalized, real-time guidance. (Requires an active Brilyi subscription, standalone value: $49/mo)

All together, these features represent over $209/month in combined value—delivered for just $14.99/month.

For a limited time, we are now including all of the above features in our free version. Note that we reserve the right to exclude them from the free version at any time in the future and while they are in the free version to include promotions and affiliate product links in the content displayed in the free version.

  • ✏️ Advanced shortcode control for full layout customization
  • 🎨 Flexible design options to match your site perfectly
  • 🔒 Disable all affiliate links and calls-to-action
  • 🧘 No API fees, no upsells, no astrology knowledge required
  • 💸 14-day free trial + 30-day money-back guarantee

To see examples of what you can do with the Premium version, click here.
Also check out this demo site to see more of what is possible with this plugin: ImmortalUnion.Com.

Our core platform is free and has everything you need to display beautiful and engaging horoscopes for each of the zodiac signs.

  • Captivate Your Audience with Mesmerizing Daily Horoscopes – Deliver compelling, beautifully crafted horoscopes for all 12 zodiac signs, keeping your readers coming back for more.
  • Fresh Daily & Weekly Horoscopes – Automatically updated content ensures your readers always have the latest astrological insights at their fingertips.
  • Skyrocket Your Traffic & Ad Revenue – Engage readers with captivating daily content that boosts clicks, increases return visits, and maximizes your earnings.
  • Daily Dynamic Insights – Each horoscope is thoughtfully crafted with new guidance, advice, and planetary influences, keeping your content engaging, relevant, and irresistible to readers.
  • Cosmic Accuracy Powered by NASA – We harness NASA’s astronomical ephemeris to calculate daily cosmic influences, ensuring precise and reliable astrological guidance.
  • Never Miss a Retrograde – Get real-time tracking and in-depth insights on every planetary retrograde, revealing how each one influences your zodiac sign’s journey.
  • In-Depth Planetary Aspects – From trines to oppositions and beyond, every celestial alignment is expertly interpreted and tailored to each zodiac sign’s horoscope.
  • Moon Phases & Mystical Folklore – Uncover the influence of each lunar phase and its rich folklore, helping your readers forge a deeper cosmic connection.
  • Powerful Fixed Star Influences – From Sirius to Regulus, our plugin tracks and interprets daily planetary conjunctions with 15 major fixed stars, bringing deeper cosmic insights to your horoscopes.
  • Effortless Setup – Up and running in minutes with a simple shortcode —no coding required. Start offering daily and weekly horoscopes that keep your audience coming back!
  • Customizable Design – Tailor the look of your horoscopes to match your website’s unique style. Adjust background colors, fonts, and sizes to create a seamless experience that fits perfectly with your theme.
  • Premium Features Available – Upgrade to the premium version to unlock advanced features, including tarot Cards, numerology, and individual horoscope components for greater customization of the look and feel of your horoscopes, as well as the ability to disable affiliate promotions, links, and call-to-actions.

Affiliate Disclosure

Some of the content generated in the free version of this plugin may include affiliate links and promotions. This means that if users click on a link and make a purchase, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. This helps support the continuous development of the plugin and the servers and bandwidth to deliver the content. These links and promotions can be disabled in the Premium Version.

Premium Features

Upgrade to the Premium license for enhanced customization and support:

Advanced Shortcode Control
Use the shortcode [ezhp_ezhoroscope_section sign=”zodiac sign” section=”horoscope section” language=”languageCode”] to create custom horoscope pages. Mix and match components with your own design elements to build unique astrological content that updates automatically every day.

Customizable Components

  • Guidance section
  • Advice section
  • Reflection section
  • Lunar phase information
  • Individual sun and planetary aspects
  • Detailed cosmic guidance

Enhanced Customization

  • Flexible headline tag control
  • Remove or modify top headlines
  • Custom layout options
  • Complete control over page design
  • No affiliate promotions or links

Premium Content Features

  • Professional Tarot card readings (English, with more languages coming soon!)
  • Comprehensive Numerology calculations (English, with more languages coming soon!)
  • Sun Sign Compatibility Reports (English, with more languages coming soon!)

Your horoscope pages maintain professional accuracy while matching your site’s unique style. All content updates automatically daily, ensuring fresh astrological insights for your visitors.

This data is used solely for tracking plugin activations and improving our services. We do not collect any personal user information.

For more information, please see our privacy policy at:
https://www.enneagramzoom.com/Home/Privacy

Voice Agent Usage

  1. Go to EZ Horoscope → Voice Agent Settings in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Enter your Brilyi API key and select your voice agent.
  3. Copy the generated shortcode (example: [ezhp_voice_agent id="your-agent-id"]).
  4. Paste the shortcode into any post or page.
  5. A “Talk to our AI” button will appear, allowing visitors to chat with your astrology voice agent in real time.
  6. Check out our youtube channel for videos on how to use.
sections.installation:
Follow these simple steps to download, install, and activate the EZ Horoscope Plugin on your WordPress site:

Install the Plugin via the WordPress Repository

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard (https://yoursite.com/wp-admin).
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “EZ Horoscope Plugin.”
  4. Click Install Now, and then click Activate.

To display daily horoscopes, use the shortcode: [ezhp_ezhoroscope sign=”zodiacsign” language=”languagecode”] in your posts or pages.
Replace “zodiacsign” with the desired zodiac sign, replace languagecode with your desired language (e.g., [ezhp_ezhoroscope sign=”aquarius” language=”fr”]).

To display weekly horoscopes, use the shortcode: [ezhp_ezweeklyhoroscope sign=”zodiacsign” language=”languagecode”].
sections.faq:
Where can I access documentation?

Check out our website ezhoroscope.com . Each of the sample pages show the shortcodes used to display the content.

How do I display a horoscope for a specific zodiac sign?

Use the shortcode [ezhp_ezhoroscope sign="zodiac_sign" language="languagecode"] in any post or page. Replace zodiac_sign with one of the following:
– aries
– taurus
– gemini
– cancer
– leo
– virgo
– libra
– scorpio
– sagittarius
– capricorn
– aquarius
– pisces

Example: [ezhp_ezhoroscope sign="leo" language="es"] displays the daily horoscope for Leo in Spanish. [ezhp_ezweeklyhoroscope sign="leo" language="bn"] displays the weekly horoscope in Bengali.

How often is the horoscope content updated?

The horoscope content is updated daily, ensuring fresh horoscopes are always displayed.

Is the plugin mobile responsive?

Yes, the iframe containing the horoscope content adjusts to fit mobile and desktop screens.

What languages are available?

We support 45 different languages.
Visit our ezhoroscope instructions page to see the supported languages and language codes
Language translation for sun sign compatibility coming soon.
